text:
Anika: quick async — alpha slice rollout planned tomorrow 10:00 UTC. one-line status please (what you did / blockers / today). I'll collect and coordinate. :wave:

Maya: ran perf sweep on alpha model last night. p50 ~180ms, p95 ~420ms at 1k RPS. saw memory spike around 3k RPS, kv cache evictions bumped. added small evict tweak in staging. logs: `kv_cache_evictions: 12`

Sam: merged infra change to enable warmup hooks — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1290. needs one more review for the feature-flag gating logic.

Leo: i'll review Sam's PR today, aim to finish before 18:00 PT. blocker: can't run full e2e locally because prod image tag mismatch (`redwood/serve:prod` vs `:canary`). working with infra to sync images.

Ethan: SRE check — i'll try to reproduce the memory spike on the infra side with a synthetic load. can you drop a few sample traces and a representative request payload? i'll also add a temporary datadog watch: `monitor:alpha-canary-memory`

Anika: dropping a couple traces here — sample query you can run: `logs-query: service:inference env:alpha "eviction" | sort @timestamp desc limit 20`. attaching minimal payload used in perf test.

deploy-bot: Build #3501 passed on main and tag `alpha-rollout-3501` pushed :white_check_mark:

Sam: FYI CR for the feature flag rules: https://github.com/redwood-inference/flags/pull/212. small nit: timeout default 6s -> we should bump to 8s for alpha, otherwise we see borderline errors under burst.

Leo: leaving comments on Sam's flag PR. once tests pass i'll +1. also will add note to runbook about affinity fallback behavior.

Maya: heads up — quant profile changed between model builds; if we don't pin `quant-v1.2` latency increases ~20%. opened model pin PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/547

Anika: good catch. can we gate that behind a flag? suggested: `alpha_model_variant=quant-v1.2` so rollout is deterministic.

Ethan: added temporary feature flag `alpha_force_quant` in the console and set to OFF. will flip once we confirm infra and PRs are green. i'll also watch `allocs` and `oom` metrics during the flip.

ops-bot: alert rule `alpha-canary-latency-5m` configured (threshold >500ms). currently no active alerts.

Sam: today i'm finishing the rollout doc (steps + validation queries + rollback). blocker: need a short snippet explaining session affinity fallback — anyone own that paragraph?

Leo: i'll write the session affinity paragraph and link the small runbook by 08:30 UTC.

Maya: tests summary: ran a small set of end-to-end prompts, 1 failure with very long context (>8k tokens). i've opened issue #893 for follow-up and flagged model-team.

Anika: plan: if PRs and infra checks are green, aim to flip the FF at 10:00 UTC, monitor slice for 15 minutes. abort criteria: >=3 user-facing errors or sustained p95 > 600ms. i'll post a short rollback checklist in the doc. :memo:

Ethan: SRE stands by and will be on-call 09:45-11:15 UTC. i'll also enable an emergency capacity bump policy if we see cache thrash.

Anika: i'll ping all 5m before flip and post a status update at +5m and +15m. thanks everyone — keep short updates here if anything pops. :pray:

Maya: +1. will watch logs and report any evictions spike immediately.

Sam: pinged security for a quick read of the flag audit trail.

Leo: approved infra PR after tests. leaving a tiny comment on timeout doc.

Anika: great — closing collection. i'll update the rollout doc and post the final link here once done.
